title: Nova Scotia Neighborhood
content: I've had the same recurring dreams for years. The dreamscape is a lot like everyone on this sub, a world with a mall, buildings, beaches, neighborhoods. And just like a lot of people on this sub, my dreamscape has been dramatically changing over the last couple months. For some reason Canada is always a big part of my dreamworld. Last night I dreamt of some Nova Scotians moving into my neighborhood. I don't know why but Canadians make me feel comfortable, so in dreamworld I was so happy to see them, but the rest of the neighborhood was firmly upset. Thanks Canadaians!
